approved: Australian Broadcasting Corporation Amendment (Appointment of Directors) Bill 2018
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill aims to make the process for choosing non-executive members of the ABC's board more independent and transparent.
It would change the appointment rules to match the merit-based system that was introduced by a 2012 law.
The new rules would start the day after the bill becomes law.
It would strengthen the independence and autonomy of the director appointment process.
It would increase transparency and integrity in how non-executive directors are chosen.
It would align the appointment process with the merit-based arrangements from 2012.
The ABC and the people appointed as non-executive directors to its board.
